search_window.basis: Conservative overlap from the last independently verified Food Line recall heartbeat completion (07:02:13 PDT). Nominal immediately preceding hourly check was 09:45:54 PDT, but its durable heartbeat was not independently identified; discovery included the previous day for lagged indexing, without treating old material as new.

focus_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution due to storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or material service-access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance benefit or service interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; production Food Line nationwide collection remains authoritative.
Exactly 12 targeted web searches completed without search tool failures. Searches used a one-day index recency filter, but qualifying source publication/incident timing was reviewed separately.
No verified U.S. disruption first reported within the conservative Pacific observation window satisfied the four eligible high-value classes.

Search results primarily surfaced old/nonqualifying examples: Spencer, New York only-grocery fire reported September 14, 2026 (https://www.wbng.com/2026/09/14/town-spencer-recovering-after-losing-only-grocery-store-fire/); July 2026 DeKalb, Georgia Ingles fire; 2025 SNAP shutdown coverage. These are excluded as older events.
October 24 Kaua‘i hurricane recovery coverage did not substantiate a newly canceled emergency food distribution; no eligible timely disruption was verified.

Coverage limits: sparse same-hour index results and social-media announcement access; search result crawl timestamp was not mistaken for a source publication timestamp. Exact absence of nationwide events cannot be established from a bounded recall watch.
Excluded donation drives, resource guides, general inflation stories, program promotion, opinion, non-U.S. content, stale sources, and duplicates.
